changes.after: Let the last digit be d, so the digits are 3d, 3d−1, 2d, d. The only possible last digits are 1, 2, and 3. When d=1, the digit 2 repeats, so it is invalid. When d=2, the number is 6542; when d=3, the number is 9863. Both satisfy every stated constraint.
